user_query: I'm starting a new business and I need to register a domain name. Before finalizing the domain, I want to check the availability of the domain and retrieve its DNS records. Can you help me perform a DNS lookup for the domain 'example.com' using the DNS Lookup API? Additionally, fetch the bank account verification result for the request ID '68bbb910-da9b-4d8a-9a1d-4bd878b19846' using the Bank Account Verification API.

TaskList.description: Perform a DNS lookup for the domain 'example.com' to check its availability and retrieve DNS records.
Fetch the bank account verification result for the request ID '68bbb910-da9b-4d8a-9a1d-4bd878b19846'.
